description: Defines the ToCopy class in the torch::lazy namespace, representing a node for the '_to_copy' operation in the lazy tensor backend of PyTorch. The class includes methods for constructing, reusing, string representation, and lowering the operation to a graph.

classes.name: ToCopy
classes.description: Represents a lazy tensor node for the '_to_copy' operation, encapsulating parameters like dtype, layout, device, pin_memory, non_blocking, and memory_format, with methods for node management and lowering.

methods.name: ClassOpKind
methods.description: Returns the operation kind for the '_to_copy' operation.

methods.name: ToCopy
methods.description: Constructor for the ToCopy node, initializing parameters and base class.

methods.name: CanBeReused
methods.description: Checks if the current node can be reused given new parameters.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including parameters.

methods.name: Lower
methods.description: Lowers the node to a graph operation using the provided function and context.
